title: Find al dente
summary: Learn when pasta is tender with a little bite.
ingredients: A small sample of cooking pasta
notes: Use the packet or active recipe timer; never invent a cooking duration. No rinsing is needed for the bite test.

steps.instruction: Near the packet or recipe check time, lift out one piece of pasta with a spoon and let it cool briefly.
looks_right: one pasta piece on a spoon or plate
steps.done_when: One piece is cool enough to taste.

steps.instruction: Bite the piece. Look for a tiny white dot at most, with no broad chalky core.
looks_right: centre has no broad white chalky core
steps.done_when: The cook reports tender pasta with a slight bite; a thin white dot is acceptable.

steps.instruction: If the centre is chalky, keep cooking and taste another piece. When it has a slight bite, drain it; no rinse needed.
looks_right: pasta drained after a successful bite test
tubes or strands hold their shape
looks_wrong: draining while the centre is still chalky
steps.done_when: The cook confirms a slight bite and the pasta is drained.
